brief: Choose how the service parses its configuration file so that unknown keys are reported rather than dropped.

criteria.text: Unknown keys are reported with their line.
Error messages a new contributor can act on.

candidates.label: Candidate C
candidates.dropout: Returned no runnable artifact within the budget.

comparison: A reports unknown keys with their line using the existing parser's positions; B reports them without lines, violating the first hard constraint.
decisive_reasons: Only A meets both hard constraints.

contributions.what: B's wording for the unknown-key message.

premises.premise: The existing parser exposes key positions.

counterexample.case: A key nested under a list item.
counterexample.check: Parsed a fixture with an unknown key inside a list entry.
counterexample.result: Reported with its line; the choice holds.

position.why: It meets every hard constraint on the project's own parser.
conditions: A parser swap would reopen the choice.
